about: Hayle Surf School is based at Beachside Holiday Park in Phillack, in the dunes above St Ives Bay. It teaches all levels, from complete beginners to experienced surfers, in groups of no more than eight per instructor. It also hires out boards and winter wetsuits and runs a café on site.
offers: Group lessons tailored to individual ability
where: Beachside Holiday Park, Lethlean Lane, Phillack, Hayle, TR27 5AW (Hayle Towans)
goodToKnow: Maximum of eight students per instructor
Instructors hold Surf Coach Safety and Rescue and ISA coaching qualifications
